# Intrinsics sensitivity

No Stage2 parameters were refit. The Stage2 final candidate was evaluated alongside the recorded 28-run LOPO ensemble and deterministic 80% subsample ensemble. One-at-a-time tests use each parameter's recorded Stage2 LOPO p05–p95 range.

Nominal height slope: **52.8937 mm/m**.

Stage2 LOPO ensemble height-slope distribution: `{"min": 50.046624650634406, "p05": 50.69206771243054, "median": 52.92018536670609, "p95": 54.62226157120697, "max": 55.34001977541979}`.

Stage2 80% subset ensemble height-slope distribution: `{"min": 44.11721955148521, "p05": 48.431026458028825, "median": 53.07574615956398, "p95": 58.0690131492426, "max": 60.823049043839916}`.

Most sensitive one-at-a-time parameter: **fx**, whose full recorded LOPO p05–p95 span changes the slope by **36.4115 mm/m**. See JSON for every endpoint and full ensembles.

Interpretation must separate sensitivity from blame: if reasonable Stage2 variants retain a large same-sign slope, Stage2 uncertainty is a contributor/conditioning amplifier rather than a sufficient root cause.
